title: OAB Architecture Decision Record
description: The YAML frontmatter contract for an ADR. The prose sections are defined by templates/adr.md; this schema governs the machine-readable part, so that a repository's decisions can be queried, and so revisit conditions cannot be omitted.

id.description: Zero-padded and sequential within the repository.

complexity_delta.description: Change in complexity points from this decision. Negative is a simplification, and recording those is as valuable as recording additions.

reversibility.description: How hard this is to undo. One-way doors justify more analysis; a reversible decision made quickly usually beats a perfect decision made slowly.

triggers.description: Ids of the evolution triggers that reopen this decision. A decision without one is a decision nobody can safely revisit.

then.description: An accepted decision must carry at least one measurable revisit condition.
A superseded decision must say what replaced it, or the trail breaks.
